slides.notes:
VOCATIONAL-BUILD-A2-W06 · Year A · Friday 11 December 2026
Term theme: Identity & Belonging
Thread tags: SMSC S/So (M/C: none); British Values IL/MR (D/RL/T: none).
We Do: 5 minutes.
Teacher: Show the separate adult card with three strips laid loosely on the front, one sticking beyond the edge. Ask: “Glue now, or check and move the strip first?” Expected: adjust the layout before gluing. If unsure, point to the card edge, rephrase, offer a choice and model one adjustment. Parallel recheck: the strips fit but cover the space for Welcome; move the design or word strip before gluing.
First and then: First place and check the paper. Then glue and finish the card.
Routes: Supported: Offer a pre-folded blank, large pre-cut strips and one step card at a time. The learner chooses, places or presses pieces with agreed support. Record which parts they did; adult preparation is not learner evidence. Independent: Choose paper colours, fold the card, arrange and secure the three strips, add Welcome and check the item and work space with the agreed safety supervision. Aspire: Complete the same item, explain how the arrangement fits the front and improve one feature after a check. Keep the same safe materials; a more complex or neater design is not required.
Evidence: An individual winter welcome card or clearly recorded unfinished item, linked to dated observations of planning, making, checking, support and one response to feedback.
Careers: This helps me follow a plan, make an item and check it.
Source: scheme_references/BUILD_SOW.xlsx; BUILD Weekly - Autumn, C142; owner-confirmed strand and Friday slot.
This lesson selects the craft option of the food/craft row. Use paper, card and staff-approved classroom adhesive only. Adults pre-cut pieces, manage caps and any sharp equipment, check access needs and supervise adhesive use. No food, heat, glitter, beads, loose string or hot glue is used. Keep materials away from mouths. Offer larger pieces, an adult-prepared fold or a chosen simpler pattern; record the learner’s actions and adult help. A winter pattern is a design choice; no personal celebration, family detail or named recipient is required. Store the item safely while it dries.
